market.title: The Odyssey — Best Picture Winner, 99th Academy Awards
resolutionNote: Resolves on the official Best Picture winner announced at the 99th Academy Awards ceremony.
Kalshi's own wording: "If The Odyssey has won Best Picture at the 99th Academy Awards, then the market resolves to Yes."

No Polymarket winner market exists yet - Polymarket currently only lists a separate Best Picture NOMINATIONS market for The Odyssey (a different question: whether it's nominated at all, not whether it wins), so this page tracks Kalshi only until/unless Polymarket opens an equivalent winner market.

text: The Odyssey is the latest release from acclaimed director Christopher Nolan, who already secured Academy Award success in 2024 for Oppenheimer, winning Best Director and Best Picture.
Critics are almost unanimous in their praise of The Odyssey, which opened to $123.5M in the US and $263.7M worldwide in July.
Thanks to a stellar cast and an impressive IMAX format, it's Nolan's biggest global debut ever, which is no mean feat given a back catalog that includes The Dark Knight and Inception.
Biggest competitors in this category, according to prediction markets, include upcoming releases Dune: Part Three and Digger.
